# A project with no forge runs a workflow that calls merge(). The run refuses at the call: stderr names the file and the line of the call and says that the project has no forge.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

subst config/projects/local.star

exec obeereal item add local ship-it --title 'Ship it' --body-file body.txt

exitcode 1 obeereal run ship-it local --workflow flow/merge.star
stderr 'merge\.star:3:'
stderr 'project local: no forge; set forge = "github" in the project file'
! stdout 'finished'

# The claim of the item is released, and the run ends as failed.
noclaims local
exec obeereal status
stdout '^item-ship-it-r1\tfailed\titem ship-it of [a-z]+$'

-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- body.txt --
Ship the change.
-- config/projects/local.star --
project(
    source      = "@WORK@/origin",
    base_branch = "main",
    gate        = "true",
    test_report = "r.xml",
)
-- flow/merge.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "before", run = ["git", "--version"])
    merge(head = "abc123", merge = False)
